# Check: upstream truncate-to-width.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/truncate-to-width.test.ts

## Subject
Text truncation preserving ANSI codes; visibleWidth helper.

## Upstream test count (approx)
6 (covering ~9 assertions)

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- keeps output within width for very large unicode input
- preserves ANSI styling for kept text; resets before and after ellipsis
- handles malformed ANSI escape prefixes without hanging
- clips wide ellipsis safely and brackets it with resets
- returns original text when it already fits even if ellipsis is too wide
- pads truncated output to requested width
- adds trailing reset when truncating without ellipsis
- keeps contiguous prefix instead of skipping wide grapheme and resuming later
- visibleWidth: counts tabs inline and skips ANSI inline

## Upstream dependencies
truncateToWidth, visibleWidth from ../src/utils.js

## Upstream notes
truncateToWidth(text, width, ellipsis, shouldPad). Inserts ellipsis when text exceeds width; adds \\x1b[0m before and after ellipsis. Tabs count as full width; ANSI escape sequences don't count toward visible width. Handles malformed ANSI prefixes safely.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs
- grep for truncate in apps/octo_pi_tui/test

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
